reason: Applies the prediction-level needs-stale judgement, which found the week's evidence had split the three modelled actors apart. The consumer-hardware model-release actor substantially delivered - a 27B-class build fitting a handset at 3.9 GB on 2026-07-15, a 2.8T open sparse flagship taking first on a frontend coding arena on 2026-07-17, and a further flagship refresh on 2026-07-19 - so that Need rolls forward to sustaining cadence rather than clearing the bar once. The editor and enterprise-platform actors produced no evidence at all across the entire runway; the editor Need is kept, since the prediction's landing text names it, but rewritten to state the non-delivery honestly, and the enterprise-platform actor is folded into the new third actor rather than carried as a second empty row. That third actor comes from bridge validation.3cab277c2cb7cb4c (2026-07-18), which surfaces the agent-gateway and governance vendor the Need-set did not model at all - the party actually moving close to 10 trillion tokens a month and applying the routing policy the prediction attributed to editor vendors. All three windows are moved into Q3 2026 per the judgement; they previously expired 2026-06-30, one day before the prediction's own target window opens, so this is a genuine timing correction rather than a wording change.
